findings.value: Carcass-contact uncleanness (mortuary/dietary domain) is contracted PASSIVELY by touch, SPREADS to the person, and is reset by WASHING + WAITING until evening - never by atonement/covering. It runs AUTOMATICALLY (awareness not in view) and lapses the same day (temporal=until-evening): a momentary remedy of the immediate past, not a forward standing. This is the BODILY pole of the clean/unclean axis - contrast the MORAL pole (sin), which is aware-triggered and reset by atonement(cover).  [Strong's: H2930, H2931]
